name: calendar-update-event
description: Modify a calendar event. Send only the fields that change. An occurrence's id edits only it; its masterEventId edits the series (recurrence changes go there; UNTIL ends a series). attendees replaces the whole guest list, not a per-person patch (see its notes; the principal's own RSVP is calendar-respond-to-invite). Guest-list and time changes send invitation emails by default. notifyAttendees=false suppresses them (see its caveats).

inputs.title: string?
inputs.attendees: object[]? (full guest-list replacement: each { email, name? }. Cannot set RSVP status. Replaces membership; RSVP preservation on retained guests is unverified — re-read after writing.)
inputs.conferencing: object? (new link: { provider: Google Meet/Microsoft Teams, autocreate: true }. Zoom/other existing link: { provider, details: { url } })
inputs.recurrence: string[]? (the series' new RRULE line only; cancel one occurrence with calendar-delete-event)
inputs.notifyAttendees: boolean? (default true. false suppresses invitation emails on Google only; Microsoft rejects false, iCloud ignores it.)
inputs.mailbox: string? (mailbox id; required for an unregistered calendar or "primary" when several are connected)

outputs.warnings: string[]? (notifyAttendees=false caveat, and guest-list mismatches after a write that already applied)
